meta.plant_name: South Fond Du Lac power station

Backup Power.note:
Backup power:
- Open the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources air permit 42010166A-P40 from October 30, 2024 at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1190486 and read the facility description. It says the site is authorized to operate an electrical generation facility and lists 'FOUR SIMPLE COMBUSTION TURBINES' as the main emission units.
- The permit describes the four turbines as grid power generators. Only the small diesel fire pump and an emergency engine are described as emergency equipment.

What this means:
- The value no for Backup Power stands. The permit does not say the turbines are backup power, and it does not state backup power in words, so this is a partial confirmation.

units.notes: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx), Plant 7203, generator CT1, status OP, nameplate 95.4 MW, operating May 1993, no planned retirement. No retirement, mothballing or owner change was found, so the unit stays operating.
